automated.summary: The repo-wide quality baseline verifies green with all four FACTORY_* overrides unset, which is the precondition that makes a local green trustworthy: verify.py prefers a pre-set environment variable over .envrc, so FACTORY_QUALITY_CMD=true would otherwise produce a false pass. verify.py reports Verification passed across structural (build + dual-runtime + vendor integrity), typecheck (both workspaces, no-emit), quality (ESLint + Prettier) and test (hermetic backend + the quality-gate guard). The required guard test emits a matching, attributable JUnit testcase.
commands_run: env -u FACTORY_STRUCTURAL_CMD -u FACTORY_TYPECHECK_CMD -u FACTORY_QUALITY_CMD -u FACTORY_TEST_CMD npm run verify:ci
env -u FACTORY_STRUCTURAL_CMD -u FACTORY_TYPECHECK_CMD -u FACTORY_QUALITY_CMD -u FACTORY_TEST_CMD python3 factory/scripts/verify.py
npm run build:contract && npm run build:backend && npm run typecheck
npm run lint && npm run format:check

TS_NODE_PROJECT=backend/tsconfig.json node tools/junit-run.mjs --file tools/quality-gate.test.mjs --name "the four FACTORY commands are declared in .envrc and name scripts that exist" --report {report} --require ts-node/register
tests_added_or_updated: tools/quality-gate.test.mjs — new 326-line guard asserting the command graph SEMANTICALLY and recursively to every runnable leaf (root and workspace lint/format:check/typecheck bodies and the test body), so repointing any leaf at a no-op fails rather than passing on a name match; pins the two required .prettierignore headers, rejects directory wildcards in the vendored exclusions, pins a SHA-256 baseline per D-0006 file so an edited ignored file cannot remain exempt after commit, and pins the CI push-only trigger and permissions stanza

backend/src/atlasTokens.test.ts — REMOVED (D-0005): it read frontend/app/globals.css at import time and threw, because decision 0006 excluded the vendored Pulse frontend; frontend-foundation owns equivalent 3F token coverage
automated.pass_fail_summary: verify.py: Verification passed. Hermetic backend suite: 33 passed, 1 opt-in skipped, 0 failed. Guard test: 1 passed. The 42 DB-backed tests across 8 files are host-only demonstrated evidence per D-0008 and are not part of this automated gate.
remaining_gaps: D-0006: 71 pre-existing vendored files are excluded from FORMAT checking. The exclusion is explicit, file-by-file, and self-liquidating — the guard pins a content hash for each, so editing one fails until it is formatted and removed from the list.
D-0007: backend test files are type-checked by nothing — backend/tsconfig.json excludes them and the suite now runs transpile-only. Previously true in practice, now true by design.

D-0008: 42 DB-backed tests (auth, RBAC, audit, warehouse) are not enforced by CI; they need a migrated Postgres app DB and run on the host. The hermetic/DB split is by declared file list rather than a silent glob.

The guard does not yet fail on an UNCLASSIFIED backend test — one in neither test:hermetic nor test:db. Implied by the contract's explicit-list requirement; left to the autoreview rather than a further contract cycle.
D-0008's text says 42 tests where the eight DB-backed files hold 50 test leaves; the file boundary is correct, the count is not.
